svg.title: WhiteTree Activity Core
svg.desc: WhiteTree maps the year as a tree: each month is a major branch, each week a sub-branch, and each active commit day a twig whose bud size reflects authored commit intensity. Extra organic forks keep the canopy tree-like without changing the data hierarchy. Mind and Work form the roots. The footer separates authored commit statistics from GitHub contribution-calendar totals.
svg.text: MONTH → BRANCH WEEK → SUB-BRANCH ACTIVE DAY → TWIG

g.text: ACTIVITY SUMMARY · CONTRIBUTIONS = GITHUB 365-DAY CALENDAR THROUGH SEP 25 UTC
